description: Use right before building a transaction you will sign. Blockhashes expire after about 60-90 seconds; this tells you how much time is left. Returns a fresh blockhash plus how many blocks and roughly how many seconds remain before it expires. Inputs: network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: Free (rate-limited). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/get_solana_blockhash.
name: get_solana_blockhash
